settings.title: Log retention
settings.intro: Current logs are kept on the system disk, so they are there even without a pool. An optional archive on a pool keeps them longer.
settings.currentStatus: They take {size} now; the oldest entry is from {oldest}.
settings.maxHint: The system and all apps together, at most 4 GB. The oldest entries go first.
settings.archiveIntro: Entries are copied to the pool once a day, and before the current logs drop any. This wakes the pool's disks about once a day.
settings.archiveEnabled: Keep an archive on a pool
settings.noPool: There is no pool that can hold the archive.
settings.archiveStatus: The archive on {pool} takes {size}; last copied {copied}.
settings.archiveUnavailable: The pool {pool} cannot hold the archive now; entries wait on the system disk until it is back.
settings.archiveOnSave: The archive starts when you save.
